pages.name: Privacy Policy

path.evidence: Live reelflies.ca (channel 1) Web Page id 8 at /privacy-policy/ (Effective February 2026, last updated June 2026), read with stencil start -c 1 ?debug=context on 2026-10-06

pages.meta_description: How ReelFlies.ca (Digital Barn Ltd.) collects, uses and protects your personal information, and how to reach our Privacy Officer.

forShaun.question: The effective and last-updated dates to print once this version is approved.

Decision 11: the live policy names the Privacy Officer and gives her own mailbox. This draft gives the title, the address, the phone number and the contact form, with no email address. Add the role address once it exists, or keep the named mailbox?

The outside-Canada sentence (GEO-1 f), checked against what ticket 52 builds: the country result is kept in the browser's sessionStorage for the visit and the Stay choice in localStorage for 90 days, and neither the estimate nor the Stay choice is sent to ReelFlies. Two things to weigh before approving: (1) choosing Go sends one Google Analytics event, rf_region_go with the destination (the paired page or the ReelFlies.com home page), and only when analytics has loaded, which the consent banner gates (ticket 52, contract 6.9); (2) a Canadian time zone in the browser also stops the suggestion, so the sentence could say "from your connection and your browser's time zone". Approve the wording as drafted, or add either?
How consent is collected: the footer newsletter box with newsletter.json's wording, and the checkout checkbox that starts unticked (ticket 24). Approve?

The marked passages describe the cookie consent banner and consent-gated scripts as they are on live reelflies.ca: section 5's opening, the consent sentence of each cookie type (Functional, Analytics, Targeting), Managing Your Cookie Preferences and Privacy by Default; section 8's Google Analytics and Omnisend passages; and section 15's consent tool. Section 2's general opt-in sentence relies on the same setup. Confirm ReelFlies_CA is set up the same way before it goes live (tickets 21 and 23), or the text changes.

Live reelflies.ca has two privacy texts: this page (last updated June 2026) and an older copy (February 17, 2026) appended to About Us. This draft starts from the newer one. Ticket 22's channel-1 work adds the outside-Canada sentence to channel 1's /privacy-policy/ page, and the older copy can come off channel 1's About Us.
